name: specificity
description: Scores each prompt you submit for specificity given the session so far, and shows it as a chip beside the model that opens a breakdown panel, and under /spec.

mode.title: Judge
mode.description: haiku: a cheap Haiku call over the last few messages. fork: a tool-less fork of this session's own transcript (most accurate; bills the cached prefix against your usage). off: no model calls, no chip.

contextMessages.title: Context messages
contextMessages.description: How many recent messages the haiku judge reads (fork mode reads the whole transcript).
